name: Skeleton
summary: Hold the place of loading content with passive line, circle and block shapes under one loading status.

useWhen: Holding the place of content that is loading, in the shape and size it will take, so the page does not move when it arrives.
avoidWhen: Showing how far a task has got; use ProgressBar.
A short wait inside a control, such as a button that is submitting; use Button.
Content that is already available, or an empty result; show the content or say that there is none.

obligations: Skeleton.Root is one status region named by its label, so assistive technology reads one loading status for the whole group.
Line, Circle and Block are hidden from assistive technology, hold no text and take no focus.
The sweep is decorative: it is absent under reduced motion and under forced colours, where each shape shows as a GrayText outline.

behavior: Skeleton.Root is a div with the status role. Its label, Loading by default, is visually hidden text inside it, and the caller lays out the shapes inside it with its own markup.

Line, Circle and Block are span elements, so they are valid inside headings and paragraphs. A Line takes the height of one line of the text around it, with a bar about the height of a capital letter, so real text replaces it without moving the page.
Circle takes Avatar's sizes (sm, md, lg). Block fills its width at 16 / 9 unless a height or aspect ratio is given.

The group paints one band over all its own shapes, clipped to their outlines; a nested group paints its own. The band moves by transform alone, starts once the shapes are measured after hydration, follows them as they resize, and stops when the group unmounts.
Under reduced motion, from the system setting or a data-muxui-motion="reduced" ancestor, the band is removed and the shapes stay still.
